name: nose_cone
note: Print tip-up, 3 walls, 10% gyroid, no supports (the bulkhead is a 45 deg cone). Slides over the top insert; the latch bolt clicks into its hole. Ballast (about 90 M3 nuts + epoxy) goes into the tip through the hole in the bulkhead

name: top_latch_insert
note: PETG. Print shoulder-up, as exported. Glue 36 mm into the top of the middle tube, rib towards the payload door

name: latch_bolt
note: PETG. Bevel UP. Must slide freely; rub with graphite

name: payload_door_frame
note: PETG, print upright as exported. Epoxy inside the middle tube behind the door window (drill guide marks it); hinge pin = 1.75 mm filament

name: payload_door
note: PETG, print standing on its hinge end as exported, with a brim. Hinge pin: 22 mm of 1.75 mm filament, ends melted/glued

name: payload_door_latch_knob
note: Quarter-turn latch: knob from outside, coin slot. Print head-down, 100% infill

name: payload_door_latch_cam
note: Push onto the knob's square end from inside + drop of CA. Arm UP = locked, sideways = open

name: payload_wall
note: PETG, disc on the bed as exported, no supports. Epoxy into the middle tube, underside 160 mm from its bottom end: carries the parachute load

name: spring_piston
note: Print flat face down as exported, no supports. Sits on the spring, under the parachute

name: avbay_coupler
note: Print UPSIDE-DOWN (bulkhead on the bed), 4 walls, 25% gyroid. Its bulkhead is the payload-bay floor

name: avbay_sled
note: Print with the bulkhead disc on the bed. 4 x M2.5x8 self-tapping screws hold the PCB

name: tvc_motor_holder
note: PETG/ASA. Press/glue an M10 x 25 mm steel penny washer into the top recess (burn-through shield)

name: tvc_gimbal_ring
note: PETG

name: tvc_frame
note: PETG, print upright; supports only under the servo bars

name: tvc_motor_retainer
note: Twist-lock: push up over the lugs and turn 45 deg. For the 29 mm F35

name: tvc_motor_adapter_24mm
note: 24 mm motors only: slide it into the motor holder, then the motor into it. PETG, 3 walls

name: tvc_motor_retainer_24mm
note: 24 mm motors only (with the adapter sleeve): its 16 mm opening holds the 24 mm motor

name: tvc_motor_spacer_D
note: D20 / D12 only (70 mm long): goes into the sleeve first, above the motor. 3 walls, 30 %

name: fin_can
note: PETG, print upside-down (top ring on the bed), 3 walls, 20%, but 100% infill for the last 13 mm (the four leg tongues: a height-range modifier in the slicer). Can, 4 thick fins (servo pockets, lead channels) and the tongues the legs bolt to

name: fin_leg
note: Tough PLA, 100% infill, print sleeve-rim down as exported (layers across the leg, like the fin can: the post is then the weakest section on purpose). Print 2 spares. Slide onto the fin can's tongue, M3 x 18 button head + nut

name: fin_control_tab
note: PETG, print standing on its outer end (horn pocket down), no supports. Epoxy a servo horn, arm cut ~7 mm from the hub centre, into the pocket; the printed pin at the other end sits in the slot at the fin root

name: upper_launch_lug
note: Glue to the MIDDLE tube just above the joint screw, on the lug line: assemble the rocket, slide both lugs on the rod while the glue sets (the joint's alignment notch keeps them in line afterwards)

name: camera_pod
note: Cut a 27 x 30 mm window in the bottom tube (drill guide marks it); glue the flange

name: battery_hatch_door
note: PETG, print standing on its bottom edge as exported, with a brim (no supports). Stick a 20 x 20 mm piece of the 1-2 mm foam tape on the pad. Fit: hooks in at the top, slide up, swing the bottom in, turn the latch

name: battery_hatch_latch_knob
note: Quarter-turn latch: knob from outside, coin slot, flush. Print head-down, 100% infill

name: battery_hatch_latch_cam
note: Push onto the knob's square end from inside + drop of CA. Arm DOWN = locked, towards the middle = open

name: pad_hub
note: PETG, 5 walls, 40% infill, print upright with tree supports in the leg sockets

name: pad_rod_block
note: Tilts 0-15 deg on an M6 bolt + wing nut; M4 thumb screw clamps the rod

name: pad_rod_stop
note: Only for tilted launches: holds the rocket on the rod with its feet just clear of the tile

name: pad_leg_foot
note: Tent peg through the foot holds the pad down

name: rod_tip_safety_cap
note: Keep on the rod tip whenever there is no rocket on the pad

name: pad_tile_clamp
note: 4 corner clamps, M4 screws into the hub

name: tool_drill_guide_bottom_tube
note: Build tool (not flown). Slides over the TOP of the bottom tube: av-bay screws, static ports, switch slot, camera window, battery-hatch opening (cut along the guide's edges with a sharp knife), lug line

name: tool_drill_guide_middle_tube
note: Build tool (not flown). Slides over the BOTTOM of the middle tube: joint screws, the payload-door window and the upper-lug line

name: tool_leg_test_block
note: Build tool (not flown). PETG like the fin can, 3 walls, 100% infill, block on the bed (tongue up). Clamp the block in a vice, bolt a spare leg on and pull its foot with a luggage scale
